summary: B2Gold Corp. filed its Form 6-K containing unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing reports gold revenue of $1.948 billion and net income of $625.17 million for the six months, including a $292.374 million gain on sale of mining interests and a $49.713 million write-off of plant and equipment. This is a routine periodic financial disclosure by a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation transaction. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review is announced. The contents are standard operational and financial results, warranting no special-situations classification.
